stem.text: Which graph correctly shows the relative melting points of the elements $\text{Mg}$, $\text{Al}$, $\text{Si}$ and $\text{P}$ plotted against their relative first ionisation energies?

A.alt: Graph of melting point against first ionisation energy with Mg, Al, Si and P points: Si highest, Mg low on the left, P low on the right.

B.alt: Graph of melting point against first ionisation energy with Mg, Al, Si and P points: Al highest on the left, Si above Mg, P low on the right.

C.alt: Graph of melting point against first ionisation energy with Mg, Al, Si and P points: Si highest, Al low on the left, P low on the right.

D.alt: Graph of melting point against first ionisation energy with Mg, Al, Si and P points: Si highest, Al and Mg in the middle, P lowest on the right.
